title: My Body Song #shorts | Little Takhti
description:
Sing along with Takhti and learn about your body! Two eyes to see, two ears to hear, a nose to smell, a tongue to taste and hands to touch, with five fingers on each hand. We also sing about washing hands, brushing teeth and taking a bath, then shout the answers in a quick quiz.

Free printable worksheets, quizzes and games for this topic: https://littletakhti.com/nursery-general-knowledge-my-body-worksheets/

Little Takhti makes free learning for children in Pakistan, Nursery to Grade 3. https://littletakhti.com
